constraints.description: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy diagnose must respect declared measurement resolution and classification uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: regulatory operations director and behavioral insights lead
decision_question: Which notice, eligibility, capability, process, inspection, and enforcement stages create verified friction or unequal burden?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy diagnose must respect declared measurement resolution and classification uncertainty.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for compliance assistance and administrative-burden pathways passes documented checks for coverage, semantics, geography, timestamps, and uncertainty.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: rights-aware stage and denominator process diagnosis
independence_key.primary_outcome: eligible or regulated cases with unresolved process barriers

intended_claim: A versioned diagnose design for comparing declared alternatives affecting compliance assistance and administrative-burden pathways, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: eligible or regulated cases with unresolved process barriers
distributional gap in eligible or regulated cases with unresolved process barriers
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not label non-completion intentional noncompliance, irresponsibility, risk, or guilt.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for compliance assistance and administrative-burden pathways passes documented checks for coverage, semantics, geography, timestamps, and uncertainty.

title: Diagnose compliance and administrative-burden pathways
transportability_risks: Law, administrative burden, trust, incentives, capability, enforcement, and baseline behavior differ.
Observed compliance may reflect detection and documentation rather than underlying behavior.
